name: GetManyCertificates
label: Get Many AWS Certificate Manager Certificates
description: Lists multiple AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificates using the ListCertificates API.

fields.name: AWSServiceVaultId
fields.label: AWS Credential (Vault ID)
fields.description: Select the AWS credential to use for authentication (AWSServiceVaultId).

fields.name: ReturnAll
fields.label: Return All
fields.description: If enabled, retrieves all certificates (with pagination). Otherwise, limits results by 'Limit'.

fields.name: Limit
fields.label: Limit
fields.description: Maximum number of certificates to return (max 100). Default: 100.

fields.name: Region
fields.label: AWS Region
fields.description: The AWS region where the certificates are located (e.g., us-east-1). Default: us-east-1.

fields.name: Certificates
fields.label: Certificates
fields.description: List of certificate details (ARN, Domain, Status, CreatedAt, Type).

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from AWS Certificate Manager.
